notes.title: Update - Multiplayer says goodbye!
notes.notes:
Multiplayer has been removed from Fossilfuel with this update.

It seems that not many people are actively engaging in the multiplayer aspect of the game, almost all new players are playing the single-player. It doesn't make much sense to promote the game as a multiplayer experience at this point as the servers are empty. 

Additionally, I'd like to remind you that the Fossilfuel 2 store page is now live. Be sure to follow updates for the exciting continuation of the epic Fossilfuel storyline!

Dangerous Bob

notes.title: Patch V1.15 Motion Blur toggle and more!
notes.notes:
Hello, all you Dino shooter fans, 

DangerousBob here, 

Your voices have been heard! Changes in this patch:


 Motion Blur can be toggled in the Settings.

 Load From Last Checkpoint added to the in-game menu.

 Rare Guns are more readily available towards the end of the game.

 Added Cull Volumes to the larger maps to help with FPS (mainly the Power Plant.)

notes.title: Patch v1.14
notes.notes:
Changes include 

-The Trench part on the Surface level has been made a bit easier. 

-The AI for the Spetsnaz has been tweaked. They are a bit more aggressive and track the player better.

---

Achievements not unlocking fix:
If your Achievements are not working, this was an old bug that I have been working on and now have a fix, the way to fix it is to go to your AppData/Local/Fossilfuel/Saved/SaveGames folder and delete the .sav files.

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.notes:
-Placeable Turrets are now much more deadly. 
-There was a bug where you could shoot in the shop menu, that is fixed.
-Added the player stats back to the inventory menu (money and XP)
-You cant use the health items now if you have full health. This should help with the accidental use of health items.

notes.title: Patch 1.12
notes.notes:
1.12

-Fixed achievement bug with Lizard Man and Queen Bug.
-Fixed Controller bug with bumpers in the menu.
-Some other bugs with the cheat menu after the game was complete. 
-Some minor gameplay tweaks, fixed where players were glitching and jumping down with the Trex in the hanger fight.

notes.title: v 1.10 Bug fixes - Sniper Crosshair bug and others
notes.notes:
This patch fixes the following:

The sniper crosshair would get stuck up on the screen if you switched weapons while zoomed in. 

The inventory had a bug where you could stack ammo of different types together (surprised nobody noticed this one earlier.)

I tweaked the enemies so they are not so jerky when they turn around corners.

notes.title: V 1.08 Horde mode bug fixes
notes.notes:
Following bugs have been patched. 

The horde mode would get stuck on waves even though all enemies were killed. This has been fixed. 

Fixed the grenades not loading on the ammo crates for client-side users.

The Titanoboa snake in singleplayer animation is smoother now and not so jerky when it moves. 

Players start multiplayer with $200 vs $0.

notes.title: UPDATE v0.5 COOP MISSION FREE ROAM and more!
notes.notes:
Hello!

In the Multiplayer you can now toggle what is called "COOP MISSIONS". This will be an area where new COOP maps can be added that have objectives vs the standard Horde mode. 

A new map has been added for this mode. FREE ROAM! You are on the surface of Sierra, you and your buddies can hunt down the enemy, make your own adventure and achievement hunt!

Tweaks: 

-Increase Shotgun fire rate 20%
-V-Sync works now
-Invert Pitch option added
-You can jump in mp with space bar now (Mp grenade throw key has been moved to [ALT])
-Fix the drone enemy
-Added Mouse sensitivity slider
-Key bindings have been cleaned up
-You can't just run past the Snake Boss now, you have to fight
-A Death Screen when you die
-Gamma brightness options

Please continue to post bugs as you find them! That is a big help.

Happy hunting, 

DangerousBob

notes.title: v0.3: Day 2 Bug fixes continue!
notes.notes:
v0.3 

Just doing some quick bug fixes that come with the joys of early access.

Fixed a bug in regards to the fence on the Surface level, where the hitbox of the fence was too high and players could not jump over it. 

Fixed the texture on the columns in the trainyard. 

Allosaurus now gives 50XP when killed vs 25. 
Heavy Soldiers now give 25xp when killed.

Fixed some other minor hitbox errors. 
C4 is default key mapped to G now. 

Added a new floor model to the main menu.

notes.title: We have all the problems of a major theme park and a major zoo! Day one bug fix
notes.notes:
v0.2

Hello all! 
Day 1 bug fixes from players reporting in. 

Fixed 2 big bugs, 1 were a lot of the enemies were simply not spawning. You may notice how empty the game has been. 

Fixed a big bug in the Sublevel with the first Paddoc door code. Basically, there was a missing document that had the code to the door that wasn't spawning. Anyway, that has been added back in...

Happy playing and keep reporting bugs!
